content:
Nate (CS): FYI — onboarding call with TempoHealth. They want clearer mapping of per-team costs in console. Capture thread for product.
Lina (CSE): Notes from call: 1) per-route cost breakdown by team label, 2) ability to pin model variants per route, 3) exportable CSV for monthly chargebacks.
Ajay - PM: thx. Is this mostly UI or API? @Lina
Lina (CSE): Mostly UI but needs backend aggregation. They want daily snapshots and an API to pull last-30d delta.
Sam (Eng): we already have per-route token counts. adding team label agg + CSV export ~ 2 wks dev + infra. depends on query perf.
Olivia (ProductOps): can we triage priority? renewal at risk if we don't give better chargeback controls — client said renewal contingent. :grimacing:
Miro (DataSci): also asked for embedding-quality metrics per-customer to explain drift. Not sure where to surface that.
Ajay - PM: OK, proposal: quick win = CSV export + per-route label agg (can ship as beta). Next = per-team dashboard + model pin UI. I'll create a JIRA. @Sam can you estimate in more detail?
Sam (Eng): will check infra cost for daily aggregation. Could be a cron job + materialized view. Estimate: 8-12 dev days.
Nate (CS): Customer is happy with a beta CSV in 2-3 weeks. They're probing renewal next month so we should try to prioritize.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: RLW-1427 — 'Chargeback export & per-team cost agg' by Ajay - PM
Ajay - PM: I'll add acceptance criteria: includes route, team label, tokens, model, unit cost, day.
Lina (CSE): I'll send the exact export sample to Ajay. sample columns below:
```
date,team_label,route,model,total_tokens,estimated_cost
2026-02-28,analytics,embed-route-1,redwood/fast-1,123456,1.23
```
Nate (CS): thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and reopen thread if they push for more details. :thumbsup:
